verdict.rationale: Zero's own MCP capability list documents bulk delete and bulk archive of emails, so the product itself offers bulk operations an AI agent can invoke. The evidence is only a prose list with no endpoint schema, and it relies on copying a browser session cookie for authentication. Other operations such as label modification and read/unread are not described as bulk. Missing for 10: bulk support beyond delete/archive (labels, read state), documented schema or limits for bulk calls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
